scope.method: Select recorded runtime.restoreFamilies samples; sum only samples whose parentId directly identifies one of those calls. Nested descendants are not added to their enclosing child duration. Residual is parent elapsed time minus its direct children, not independently sampled CPU self-time.

observations: Family-state reads account for +10.569268 ms of direct-child elapsed time. Native restorers improve by 2.867256 ms total and ordinary restorers by 1.010077 ms total; the residual increases by 0.642425 ms. These values account for the parent increase of 7.334360 ms.

Inventory restore median falls while its total rises slightly (52.682177 to 53.032617 ms). The second restoration at action 11 rises from 2.372944 to 8.200802 ms. The first inventory state read at action 11 rises from 9.887984 to 13.194207 ms. Both events remain in the complete arrays above.
There are 144 native-restore calls directly inside these parents; the global profile summary has 147. The three calls outside these parents must not be included in this parent decomposition.
qualifications: Diagnostic baseline isolation is not established, as recorded in isolation-deviation.json. Short unit-test runs were permitted during preparation of the baseline profiles; their exact start/end timestamps were not retained. Overlap with SMLP can neither be established nor excluded from file-edit time bounds. No STCK overlap is evidenced.

This is descriptive arithmetic over existing diagnostic samples, not causal before/after performance evidence, a new measurement, or an official budget result. The independent official window has its own baseline and isolation conditions.

Parent residual includes uninstrumented work and observer/wrapper overhead. These records do not identify an exclusive CPU cause, garbage collection, scheduler delay, memory behavior, or the specific cost of provenance marking.
Medians of separate groups do not add. A lower owner median does not imply a lower parent median or lower owner total. No sample, extreme, or unfavorable result has been removed.
